 Soha-Tanishaa Perform Dhunuchi Naach At Durga Pujo 
 By REDIFF MOVIES 
 October 21, 2026 15:49 IST 
 2 Minutes Read 
 Summarize this -->
 Listen to this article 
 Share this Article 
 x 
 Soha Ali Khan, Rituparna Sengupta, Juhi Chawla, Karan Johar came together for Durga Puja celebration. 
 Key Points
 Soha Ali Khan, Rituparna Sengupta, Juhi Chawla, Karan Johar joined Kajol and Tanishaa for the Durga Puja celebrations on the final day.
 As Durga Puja comes to an end, images from the 80th North Bombay Sarbojanin Durga Puja celebrations look vibrant and colourful, and totally an apt way of saying goodbye until next year.
 Soha Ali Khan and Tanishaa Mukerji perform the Dhunuchi Naach .
 Tanishaa and her older sister Kajol .
